ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of natural belts on a mountain; the left side at the bottom of the mountain is marked “N”, and the right side is marked “S”. The thick line in the figure represents the snow line; from the figure, the snow line is higher on the left northern slope (N slope) and lower on the right southern slope (S slope). Then reason: the height of the snow line on the two slopes of the same mountain is mainly affected by thermal conditions; the sunny slope has higher temperature and a higher snow line. If it is located in the Southern Hemisphere, the northern slope is the sunny slope and has better light and heat conditions, so the snow line on the northern slope should be higher than that on the southern slope. The figure exactly shows a high snow line on the northern slope and a low snow line on the southern slope, so this mountain is located in the Southern Hemisphere.
